note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor, after the user-namespace conversion): every tagged unit now opens with `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }`, which re-executes the test in its own user, network and mount namespace and carries the child's fail or skip to the parent (Enter, internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go), and the file builds under plain linux instead of integration && linux. RFC 9568 Section 6.4.3 says "MUST respond to ARP requests for the IPv4 address(es) associated with the Virtual Router." TestVRRPNonOwnerMasterAnswersARPWithVirtualMACOnly, otherwise unchanged, observes ARP replies for the virtual address held on the virtual-MAC macvlan and none once the address is removed; the sender hardware address read is arp[8:14]. TestPromotionInstallsIPv4AddressOnVirtualMACDevice (unchanged) proves the product installs that address on promotion only. Verdict enforced.
